title: Muni Gallery — a 3D gallery of SF bus ads
note: An independent 3D collection of Muni (San Francisco) bus advertising — 11 tech-brand bus ads plus a custom Dock concept, his own ad hung among the real ones. She asked: how can i repurpose this for myself. Her answer: the NYC version — a Subway Gallery of NYC subway ads she photographs on her commute, presented as a 3D gallery, with one custom ad of her own hung among them. Honest limit: the 3D navigation itself could not be read in text.
